title: cicuta major
intro: Cicuta major, commonly known as the giant cow parsley or cowbane, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cicuta major include its use as a diuretic, helping to alleviate fluid retention, and its potential as a sedative and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
